metadata.title: Vinorelbine and Cisplatin Therapy – 28 day

metadata.schedule_summary: A cycle lasts 28 days (4 weeks). Vinorelbine is given on Days 1, 8, 15, 22. Cisplatin is given on Days 1 and 8. Four cycles are planned, with review before doses. Delays or omitted doses may be needed for safety.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00343 Version 7. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Adjuvant treatment after complete resection of stage IB, II or IIIA NSCLC; confirm contemporary stage and MDT decision.
Locally advanced recurrent or metastatic NSCLC.

treatment.schedule_summary: Vinorelbine 25 mg/m² on Days 1, 8, 15, 22; cisplatin 50 mg/m² on Days 1, 8; repeat every 28 days for four cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity.

exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, peripheral neuropathy assessment; audiology/CrCl as clinically indicated.
FBC weekly; renal/liver profile before each cycle; hearing/tinnitus and sensory symptoms before each cycle.
Disease monitoring according to consultant plan; no universal scan or echo interval.
dose_modifications: Use this regimen-specific day/count/history and organ-function pathways; do not substitute the other vinorelbine/cisplatin schedule.
Consultant discussion of every dose modification; source gaps and discretionary reductions remain review decisions.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Select chemotherapy phase and treatment day. Cisplatin-containing days are high risk; vinorelbine-only days are minimal risk. Do not repeat cisplatin prevention on later days automatically.

notes: Vinorelbine first; cisplatin with local pre/post hydration and electrolytes. No routine take-home infusion pump.
